draft: Vicki — three deals on the clock plus 27 orphans to clear is a real load, and I see it. Block two focused hours Tuesday morning to push Sonron (GTX Plus Pro, $5,472) and re-engage Umbrella before they stall further — that's most of the $10,944 sitting in must-acts. Lean into your marketing and employment strength; you're +15pp over the team there, so play to it. You're not carrying this solo — I'm personally on the orphan cleanup and the time-critical follow-ups with you. — Celia
